query:
UPDATE identities
                SET user_type = $1,
                    password_hash = $2,
                    deleted_at = NULL,
                    updated_at = $3,
                    email_verified = $4,
                    last_login_at = NULL,
                    email_verification_token = NULL,
                    password_reset_token = NULL,
                    password_reset_expires_at = NULL
                WHERE id = $5
